name: coeffs
meaning: per-axis {p0, v, a} for the 3 outputs (x,y,z in 3-D mode); value = p0 + (t*v>>8) + (t*t*a>>15). Same block as Wolf +0x66C

name: t
meaning: arc parameter 0..0x100, advanced by g_dtMs>>2 (0x100 = 1024 ms)

name: camera
meaning: camera setup {u16 focal; u16 rot[3]; Vec3s pos} for a CamShot, or NULL; receiver zeroes it after starting

name: obj
meaning: the launched object (seesaw fills it with the object itself); in 2-D modes its current x or z is kept

name: camParam
meaning: passed as CamShot param (8th arg of Camera_StartScripted)

name: flags
meaning: LaunchArcFlags as signed one-bit fields (LaunchArcFlagBits): bit 0 no-freeze, bit 1 2-D in the ZY plane, bit 2 3-D, bit 3 the seesaw's hop
